Hey, I met you the other day! How were
the ruins? Did you find the treasure?

ever seen it... You sure are something!

That's a shame...
You went all the way there for nothing. <PART>

Don't lose hope! I'll give you this!
I found it up in the mountains.

When I grow up, I'm gonna be an adventurer!
I'll gather treasure and help the village grow!

feels like when a monster overwhelms you.

original_jp: 何だか動物達が〓えてるみたいで…一体どうしたと言うのかしら…
original_en:
All the animals are petrified!
What in the world is going on?

original_jp: 旅人がみんな ディパンが崩壊したって言うんだけど…本当なの？
original_en:
The travelers all say Dipan was crushed.
Is it true?

Mommy said the going's getting tough.

Time for me to cash in my chips and
head to the hills for safety. <PART>

original_jp: こんな急激に世情が不安定になるなんて…神のいたずらとしか思えませんわ

The world destabilized so suddenly,

Somebody up in the mountains said he saw
